summary: Frontend-only verification of the 4 user-reported fixes: (1) Exam countdown expanded layout, (2) Music player 4 defaults with edit/add/delete, (3) Global floating music widget persistence across panel-close/route-change, (4) Dark mode readability. All targeted flows PASS at 1440x900 viewport.

countdown_expanded.bbox: x=788 y=106 w=600 h=210 (right of ToolsBar, ~half of top row)
countdown_expanded.values_row_bbox: x=810 y=219 w=556 h=75 (grid-cols-4, own row - no overlap with header labels)
countdown_expanded.result: PASS: header row (label pill + title + date + 3 action icons) and 4 TimeBoxes (Gün/Saat/Dakika/Saniye) render in separate rows, no overlap; card is 600px wide as designed

verification_details.music_defaults_and_permissions: PASS: lofi-girl, chillhop, rain, forest all present with music-play-<id>; NO music-remove-<id> found for any of the 4 built-ins (correctly non-removable)
verification_details.floating_widget_persistence: PASS: music-floating appears on Play, remains visible after closing panel via tool-close, remains visible after navigating to /settings (verified via query_selector on both routes)
verification_details.min_toggle: PASS: music-min-toggle collapses/expands the iframe area
verification_details.add_custom_track: PASS: added TEST Track with youtube.com URL; music-remove-custom-<ts> button appeared for the custom track only
verification_details.edit_builtin_url: PASS: edited lofi-girl to new videoId 'jfKfPfyJRdk'; verified persistence in localStorage key 'dersim.music.custom.v1' as override entry
verification_details.music_stop: PASS: clicking music-stop removes music-floating from DOM (music halts)
verification_details.dark_mode: PASS: theme-toggle-header adds 'dark' class to <html>, body bg becomes rgb(20,20,26). Settings page renders dark-themed inputs/labels with readable contrast; dashboard header, tools bar, and countdown card remain readable. Admin page also verified.
verification_details.note_on_first_click_flake: First dark-toggle click was intercepted by the login welcome toast overlay; second attempt after waiting 5s worked. Not a bug per se, but toast could use pointer-events:none to avoid blocking header buttons briefly after login.

action_items: Minor: sonner toast in top-right can briefly overlay the header theme/settings/logout buttons right after login. Consider pointer-events:none on the toast container, or position it lower/left.
critical_code_review_comments: MusicContext.js: DEFAULT_TRACKS + customTracks merge logic uses two separate paths (tracks vs mergedTracks) — only mergedTracks is exposed but the earlier `tracks`/`playing` computations at lines 96-100 are dead code and should be removed to reduce confusion.
MusicContext.js localStorage keys are versioned (v1) — good. Extraction supports youtu.be, watch?v=, embed/, shorts/ and raw 11-char IDs.

ExamCountdown.jsx: expanded state uses `grid grid-cols-4` for TimeBoxes on its own row; header row uses flex with min-w-0 flex-1 for the title block, which cleanly prevents the overlap the user reported.
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage dersim.exam.v2 to a future date (+30 days) to test expanded countdown; added one custom music track (TEST Track with dQw4w9WgXcQ) — safe to leave, tied to localStorage only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Music widget iframe uses youtube-nocookie embed. If any videoId is region-blocked (e.g., MYPVQccHhAQ shows 'Video unavailable' in some geos), that is a YouTube-side data issue — users can override via pencil (music-edit-<id>). The play → widget → persist → stop flow was verified with chillhop (5yx6BWlEVcY) which loaded fine.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All four user complaints (overlap in expanded countdown, first track unreachable, music dying on panel close, dark-mode readability) are resolved by the current implementation.
